activity_b.text: Good morning. I’m doing today’s safety round, and I noticed the first-aid kit in your Food Technology workshop looks half-empty.
Before I write a report, can you tell me what happened?
I heard there were a few small accidents this week.
Good morning, sir. Yes, there were several minor issues.
On Monday, Amal got a small cut on his finger while slicing vegetables because the cutting board was slippery.
We used the last pack of sterile wipes to clean it.
Then yesterday, Meena had a mild burn on her hand when she touched the hot tray too quickly.
So we used up the burn gel, and we don’t have any left now.
Hmm. And what about the missing tweezers and eye drops?
Those should always be in the kit.
Those were used on Tuesday, sir.
Saman got a splinter in his finger from a cracked wooden crate.
We removed it with the only tweezers in the kit, and they accidentally fell and broke.
The eye drops were used because  Abdul got dust in his eye near the spice-grinding area.
We’re going to clean that whole section today because too much chilli powder dust is spreading.
I also saw empty bandages and no cold pack.
Was there another incident?
Yes, sir. Yesterday afternoon, Kamal had a bruise on his arm after he bumped into the heavy mixing bowl stand.
He’s fine now, but we had to use the last compression bandage.
And this morning, Thilak complained about a sore shoulder and stiff neck from lifting flour bags.
We told him he should stretch before lifting, but he didn’t warm up properly.
These are all preventable.
You have to enforce proper safety habits.
And where are the gloves?
They were listed in last month’s inventory.
The gloves finished last week, sir.
Everyone has dry hands from constant washing, so we were using gloves more often.
We’re going to request a new box today.
Alright. Last question: who had the blocked nose?
I saw it noted in your log.
That was Arjun.
He stood too close to the spice-roasting stove.
He should stay a bit farther back because the fumes are strong.
Understood. The accidents are small, but the missing items are serious.
You have to restock the kit before tomorrow.
I’m going to check again in the afternoon.
I will, sir. I’ve already made the list—we’re going to order wipes, tweezers, burn gel, bandages, cold packs, and gloves.
Everything will be ready before you return.
